conventions.convention: Minkowski coordinates are (ct,x), metric signature is (-,+,+,+), physical time is measured in seconds, and the supported rest congruence is u=∂x⁰ with g(u,u)=-1.
The flat spatial torus represents periodic fields lifted to Minkowski rest slices; spacetime itself is not quotiented.

C, κ, τ and T₀ are strictly positive constants. The quadratic effective entropy is adopted on an open neighborhood D of (0,0) contained in T₀+ϑ>0; physical interpretation requires the state to remain in D.

Global thermal evolution assumes 0∈I and the stated Schwartz or smooth periodic initial-data class. Contraction and the temperature bound concern forward time; positive temperature alone does not establish membership in D.
The radiation branch has a_R>0, T>0, ε=a_RT⁴, p=ε/3 and s=4a_RT³/3, with no conserved-number current or chemical-potential coordinate. Its unit observer u corresponds to proper-time velocity U=cu.
The radiation acoustic conclusion concerns frozen linearization about a uniform positive-temperature Minkowski rest state, not nonlinear evolution or an observed sound speed.

load_bearing.statement: Adopt Cϑ_t+div q=0 and τq_t+q=-κ∇ϑ, together with s_eff=s₀+Cϑ/T₀-Cϑ²/(2T₀²)-τ|q|²/(2κT₀²) and j_s=q/T₀-ϑq/T₀², on the declared state neighborhood D.

Smooth solutions satisfy ∂t s_eff+div j_s=|q|²/(κT₀²), ∂t e_L+div(ϑq)=-|q|²/κ and τϑ_tt+ϑ_t-(κ/C)Δϑ=0. The characteristic speed is √(κ/(Cτ)); global evolution, contraction and finite propagation use the stated conditional mathematical supplier.
Adopt ε=a_RT⁴, p=a_RT⁴/3, s=4a_RT³/3, h=ε+p, T^{ab}=h uᵃuᵇ+p g^{ab} and ∇aT^{ab}=0 for smooth positive-temperature fields with g(u,u)=-1.

Assuming countable choice, every smooth solution of the adopted radiation model satisfies ∇a(suᵃ)=0. Its frozen uniform-rest Minkowski linearization has two transverse zero characteristic speeds and longitudinal speeds ±c/√3.

concerns.concern: The Statement attributes global evolution, contraction and propagation to the exact interface in [F1], but local [F1] records only the entropy and Lyapunov identities; the evolution interface is [F3]. It also says the Schwartz data are specified in [F2], whereas local [F2] concerns characteristic speeds and the Schwartz definition is [F4]. The proof uses the appropriate Facts, so these are incorrect internal locators rather than unsupported mathematical conclusions.

alerts.finding: The second source reference names “N. Andersson and G. L. Comer, Heat conduction in rotating relativistic stars, arXiv:1804.01520v1”. The linked paper's title page identifies S. K. Lander and N. Andersson as its authors: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1804.01520. The bibliography has the wrong authors; the assigned physical consumers identify them correctly.

seams_checked.note: The consuming postulates preserve signature (-,+,+,+), length coordinates x⁰=ct, unit observer normalization and SI current conventions. Radiation explicitly converts U=cu; thermal heat flux is explicitly a physical rest-space flux. Neither branch silently adopts the earlier conserved-marker material model.

The radiation state maps, stress normalization, entropy identity and frozen acoustic spectrum match the mathematical suppliers. The Cattaneo equations, quadratic identities, propagation speed, data classes and periodic temperature bound match their supplier, with draft conditional status and the separate D-domain qualification preserved.
